subject: Approval of SMACE-003.1 Observability slice
scope: Dependency gate release for SMACE-003.2 controlled execution
basis_of_approval: PostgreSQL staging durability and read-back reported PASS
logicalWorkId continuity and runtimeJobId correlation verified
Work lifecycle, runtime execution, approval, and evidence persistence remain separate
No unauthorized Work Core primitive or locked-core modification reported

SMACE-003.2_requirements: Validate 80% budget alert including retries and failed attempts
Do not treat budget alerts as proof of actual expenditure
Reconcile actual cost against provider usage and persistent execution evidence
No new Work primitive, parallel registry, or unnecessary core refactor authorized
SMACE-003.2_acceptance_criteria: BUD-001: Alert muncul ketika penggunaan mencapai 80%
BUD-003: Failed attempt tetap masuk perhitungan biaya jika provider mengenakan biaya
BUD-005: Budget state bertahan setelah restart
BUD-006: Tenant tidak dapat membaca budget tenant lain
BUD-007: Kill switch / budget limit benar-benar mencegah side effect berikutnya
BUD-008: Actual cost direkonsiliasi dengan bukti penggunaan provider
execution_constraints.cost_separation_requirement: Pisahkan estimatedCost, reservedCost, dan actualCost. Jangan menganggap reservation sebagai pengeluaran aktual.

approval_semantics: This approval opens the next execution gate; it does not declare SMACE-003.2 shipped or production-ready.
